title: Great experience, well organized and totally worth it!
text:
Really well-organized tour from start to finish. The ride itself was very peaceful and scenic, perfect even if you don't have much experience with horses, as they were calm and well-trained. The tapas picnic afterwards was delicious, featuring a nice selection of food in a really pleasant setting. 
Everything ran smoothly on the organizational side as well- pickup was punctual, the transport was comfortable, and the guides were super friendly and knowledgeable. author: juliabU8630IU

title: Amazing day trip
text:
I had such a lovely experience and would definitely recommend it! The whole day was very well organised, and the hosts were incredibly kind and welcoming from the moment we arrived.

The horseback ride took us through beautiful countryside with amazing views, and the horses were calm, well cared for, and suitable even if you're not an experienced rider. After the ride, we enjoyed a delicious tapas picnic in a peaceful setting, which was the perfect way to relax and take in the scenery.

author: glupialaura

title: Patience with a New Rider
text: I planned this excursion for my husband, who has never been on a horse before. Mohamed was so good at teaching us how to handle the horse. He was patient and kind. It was the most amazing experience!  My husband said that out of everything I’ve planned, this was by far the most amazing.
author: Monica_V

title: Enjoyable. Worth repeating.
text:
Accommodating, packed with activities, courteous and beautiful locations with fun activities and professional presentation with the wine tasting and the horseback riding, and a superlative ending at a beach restaurant.  Pick up was punctual and in an accessible location via train or bus.

We began with horseback riding in the Penedès at a riding academy with an excellent and friendly rider who told us all about the area and important sites, as well as the vineyard which we rode through.
